[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Scoundrel's Rise | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=054 }} [[Scoundrel's Rise]] refers to the small sandy area that lies on the eastern border of [[Kryta]]. It's possible that this area used to be submerged as there are many shipwrecks dotting the area. ==Getting there== Characters must pass through this area to complete the [[primary quest]], [[To Kryta: Journey's End]]. It is the first [[explorable area]] in [[Kryta]] that Tyrian-born characters can reach. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s *Northeast, at the exit into [[Griffon's Mouth]] *Northwest, at the exit into [[North Kryta Province]] ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Camryn Jamison]] ([[collector]] for 4 [[Decayed Orr Emblem]]s) *{{x}} 2 (20) [[Monk (NPC)|Monk]] ===Foes=== [[Gargoyle]]s *{{me}} 14 (24) [[Mergoyle]] *{{e}} 12 (24) [[Mergoyle Wavebreaker]] [[Skale]]s *{{n}} 11 (24) [[Bog Skale]] *{{n}} 17 (25) [[Bog Skale Blighter]] ==Objects== [[Chest]]s *[[Krytan Chest]] ==Notes== *These quests will affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: **[[Reversing the Skales]] **[[The War in Kryta]] **[[To Kryta: Journey's End]] — many Mergoyles and Skales are replaced by [[Skeleton Mesmer]]s and [[armor rating]] against [[cold damage]] and Mergoyles use [[Mantra of Lightning]], so consider not bringing skills nor equip [[weapon]]s that deal cold nor [[lightning damage]]. ***They are all [[spellcaster]]s, so consider bringing [[anti-caster]] skills and/or various Ranger [[nature ritual]]s that can benefit your party but cannot benefit them (such as [[Favorable Winds]], [[Infuriating
